name: MisterTranslate
author: mistertranslate

sections.description:
MisterTranslate uses artificial intelligence to translate your WordPress content while preserving the original layout and design.

Supported page builders:

  • Elementor (all widgets)
  • Avia / Enfold
  • Standard WordPress editor (Gutenberg and Classic)

Key features:

  • Translate pages, posts and custom post types
  • WooCommerce product and category translation
  • Elementor segment-based translation (preserves widget structure)
  • Smart detection of translatable text fields
  • Glossary support for consistent terminology
  • Polylang and WPML integration for multilingual linking
  • Translation cost estimator
  • Batch translation support
  • WP Rocket cache purge on translation

80+ languages supported including Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Russian, Hindi and many more.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the mistertranslate folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Go to MisterTranslate > Settings and enter your API credentials
  4. Start translating from the MisterTranslate panel

To obtain API credentials, visit mistertranslate.com.
sections.faq:
What AI model does it use?

MisterTranslate uses GPT-based models optimized for translation quality and context preservation.

Does it work with Elementor?

Yes. MisterTranslate detects Elementor pages automatically and translates each widget individually, preserving all styling, colors, spacing and layout.

Does it support WooCommerce?

Yes. You can translate products (title, description, short description, attributes) and product categories.

How is the translation billed?

Translation is billed by tokens. You can check your balance and estimate costs directly from the plugin panel.
